biotools.summary: scEdU-seq is a single-cell sequencing technique for quantifying DNA replication speeds, revealing that replication speeds accelerate during S phase and are limited by transcription. The software enables researchers to investigate variability in replication speed and its associations with transcription and DNA damage.
